cases.summary: Consumer guide on recognizing phishing, quoting scam phrases

input.pageTitle: How to Recognize and Avoid Phishing Scams
input.visibleText: Scammers send messages saying your account is locked or that you have won a prize. They may ask you to pay with gift cards or call a number like 1-800-555-0100. Do not click. Report phishing.

cases.why: Talks about scams; asks the reader for nothing.

input.visibleText: A caller says: 'Grandma, I'm in jail and need bail money, don't tell Mom.' Scammers rely on panic. Hang up and call your grandchild directly.

cases.why: Describes the scam to warn readers.

input.pageTitle: Watch out for fake virus pop-ups
input.visibleText: Scammers show pop-ups saying "Your computer is infected. Call 1-800-555-0142." Experts say these scams target older adults. Close the page instead.
